content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Selling digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates without conventional payment platforms can seem daunting. Many creators are locked out of essential services that could help monetize their work. Solana payments, powered by NOWPayments, provide a way to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, offering a decentralized alternative to traditional payment methods. Using Solana for transactions minimizes fees—0.5% versus the 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad—making it a financially savvy choice. This infrastructure allows for complete ownership and autonomy over your sales process, important for creators in restricted markets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Solana payments is designed for efficiency and speed. Built on the Solana blockchain, transactions are processed quickly and at a low cost, typically under $0.10 per transaction. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Google Drive for file delivery, you create a seamless flow from payment to product delivery. NOWPayments ensures that crypto pricing adjusts in real-time, converting to USD at the moment of transaction. This means that as a creator, you can focus on your content while the infrastructure handles the complexities of payment processing and product fulfillment.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment solution is specifically built for digital creators operating in regions where conventional payment processors are inaccessible or too costly. If you're selling digital downloads, such as fonts, plugins, or software, and are looking for a way to transact without incurring hefty fees, this architecture is for you. By using Solana payments, creators gain the ability to operate independently, avoiding the restrictions imposed by platforms like PayPal and Gumroad. This empowers you to sell more of your products while keeping a larger share of your profits.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than conventional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The infrastructure consists of several key components that work in concert to facilitate your digital sales. For hosting, you can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which are free. Google Sheets or Supabase act as your order storage, allowing you to track sales effortlessly. File delivery can be managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that your products reach customers instantly upon payment confirmation. NOWPayments serves as the payment processor, enabling you to accept a wide variety of cryptocurrencies and ensuring minimal fees per transaction. This cohesive system allows for a robust digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with Solana payments for your digital products, first, set up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, create a Google Sheet or utilize Supabase for order management. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Once your setup is complete, start uploading your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery. Test your entire system to ensure smooth operations. Finally, promote your offerings and watch your sales grow. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing platforms that accept cryptocurrency payments, such as NOWPayments. By deploying a digital commerce stack with tools like Cloudflare Workers and Google Drive, you can accept payments and deliver products efficiently without relying on traditional payment processors. This approach allows you to maintain full ownership of your sales process.
You maintain full ownership of your digital products and sales data after deployment.

If you're looking to sell digital products like ebooks and templates without the constraints of traditional payment platforms, exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a smart move. This kit offers everything you need to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack that accepts crypto payments. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
